review_comment: The authorization check in test() method incorrectly allows OTP verification bypass when if_configured=True and users have no configured devices. This weakens multi-factor authentication by granting access without proper verification. Remove the bypass condition or ensure it's only used in non-sensitive contexts where OTP verification is truly optional.

The added condition creates an authorization bypass for 2FA management endpoints when if_configured=True, allowing authenticated users without OTP devices to access sensitive functionality. Remove the bypass condition to require proper OTP verification for all access to 2FA management views, ensuring only verified users can configure or modify authentication devices.
line_snippet: self.if_configured and user.is_authenticated and not user_has_device(user)

review_comment: The if_configured=True setting allows users without configured 2FA devices to access device management views without OTP verification. This weakens authorization controls for security-sensitive functionality. Require OTP verification for all users accessing 2FA device management, regardless of whether they currently have devices configured.

The access control check enforces 2FA verification for protected views, but the if_configured=True configuration creates a bypass path for users without devices. Ensure this configuration is appropriate for the sensitivity of the protected operations and consider requiring verification for all access to 2FA device management functionality.
